subject: general
question: Which one of the following is the tallest statue in the world?
solution:
The correct answer is __**'Statue of Unity' in India**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **'Statue of Unity'** in India is the tallest statue in the world, standing at a height of 182 meters (597 feet).
 
• It is a statue of Indian statesman and independence activist **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**, who was the first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister of independent India.
 
• The statue is located on the **Narmada River** in the state of Gujarat, India.
 
• It was inaugurated on **31st October 2018** by the Prime Minister of India, Narendra Modi, on the occasion of Patel's 143rd birth anniversary.
 
• The project was designed by Indian sculptor **Ram V. Sutar** and the construction was completed by Larsen & Toubro, an Indian multinational conglomerate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Spring Temple Buddha** in China, which previously held the record, is the second tallest statue, standing at a height of 128 meters (420 feet).
 
• The **Statue of Liberty** in the USA is much shorter, with a height of 93 meters (305 feet) including its pedestal.
 
• The **Great Buddha of Thailand** stands at a height of 92 meters (302 feet) and is the tallest statue in Thailand.
 
• The **Statue of Unity** has become a major tourist attraction, drawing visitors from all over the world.
 
• The statue is part of a larger complex that includes a museum and an exhibition hall dedicated to Sardar Patel's life and contributions to India.
